name: Weapon Proficiencies (D&D 2024)
description: Closed creature state containing its canonical Simple and Martial weapon-category proficiencies with fixed SRD 5.2.1 attribution. Use mechanic.dnd2024.weapon-proficiencies.write to record or correct it. An empty list means known proficiency with neither category; absence means unknown state. This component stores no individual weapon, class grant, Proficiency Bonus, attack, or damage result.
